name: Optimals Quick Calm Gummies [10 pack] | 10mg
description:
Per Package: 100mg CBD, 100mg CBG, 10mg THC 

Per Piece: 10mg CBD, 10mg CBG, 1mg THC 

This fast-acting formulation harnesses three calming cannabinoids, 30+ relaxing terpenes, and 50mg of L-theanine (the soothing amino acid found in green tea) to potentially relieve stress and temporary anxiety. With only 1mg of THC per serving, most people can take one at any time of day without feeling high. They have a 5-15 minute onset and 2-4 hour duration. And like all Wana edibles, they're vegan, naturally melt-proof, and made with organic sweeteners.
